103010.t:
A while after receiving a massive sum of 50,000,000 Credits from Midwen,
which included the retainer, the balance, and a bonus...
M.A.D. Hideout
Hey. By the way...
...?Everyone
Our last job... I mean, how long has it been since we finished Midwen's request?

Uh... let's see. Maybe a week or two?
We haven't gotten any jobs since then, so everyone's been doing their own thing.
I saw  going out to hang out with other people every single day.
Popular. The definition of a social butterfly. A human capybara.
What are you talking about? I wasn't just playing around. I was busy working part-time jobs and doing other things.
But... come to think of it, we really didn't have any major jobs...
...Was it because there was no work, or was everyone actually just too busy having fun?
Seeing how you have absolutely no memory of what you did...
Yep! You definitely had a blast playing around!
You're the one who was playing around. I'm telling you, I was actually busy.
But why are you suddenly asking about the date? Did you have an appointment or something...?
No, it's not that, but...
What did we even do... to only have about 1 million Credits left in our account?
Huh? Seriously? That's all we have left already?
N-No way...
Theta, how much did we spend, and on what...?
What, is she some kind of banking app? How would she know—
Accessing bank database. Searching records...
Approximately 34 million Credits were spent on one year of back rent, various repair and maintenance costs, and clearing overdue tabs.
In other words, you have spent 15 million Credits on living expenses alone during this time.
Why does she even have that function?
Well, at least we don't have any debt left...
So, where did that 15 million go?
...Everyone
What? Why are you all looking at me like that?
Well, I mean, you went out drinking, bought figures, bought games, and all that too, Big Boss!

S-So, it's like...
our pent-up consumer desires were awakened, or something like that...
...Hey, how much could I have possibly spent? You guys are the ones who overspent, aren't you?
Ugh, I wish I had an app that automatically keeps track of our expenses.
Analyzing spending patterns...

Lumina: Designer underwear auction.
3 million Credits spent, including living expenses.
I was half-joking, but she really has an expense-tracking function?

No, more importantly, why on earth do you buy designer underwear?
Do you even wear it?
B-But it's a brand I've wanted for a long time...

Freya: Books, toys, board games, and other miscellaneous purchases.
2 million Credits spent, including living expenses.
Why did you buy so much random stuff...? There's not a single practical thing.
Ahahaha... B-But isn't it great to have lots of fun things to do in the hideout?!

Theta.
Spent 0 Credits, including basic living expenses.

...?
Something about this number is weird too.

Hold it right there.
Don't try to pull a fast one on me.

I did not lie.
I can just eat the bread samples.
Your spending wasn't zero—you were just stealing everything?!
They are samples. This is what ingrained thriftiness and frugality look like.

Of course, I used some power to charge my boosters.
But that's a shared expense, so my spending is still 0 Credits.
*Sigh*... No wonder our electric bill was insane...

And .
For miscellaneous expenses...
Spent 10 million Credits.
...Did you say something about the electric bill?
Huh? Me?
Wait, what?

What?! So in the end, it was  who spent it all!!!
Why are you nagging us when you did that!!
No, there must be some mistake here...
This is quite disappointing, even for me.
I was satisfied with the cheapest brand, but , where on earth did you spend all that money...?

I-I don't remember!
I mean, sure, I drank, hung out a bit, and did some stuff, but...
Yeees, yeees. Sure you don't!
*Sigh*... I guess this is the start of our penniless life again...

Alright, alright, I get it..!
I'll take responsibility and make some money, so just you wait—!!
Hmph! Go ahead then!
Can you bring back some melon-flavored ice cream when you return?
I would like Mont Blanc. A large one, please.
Unbelievable, seriously.
Humanitas Street
...I talked a big game about bringing back money, but how on earth am I supposed to earn it...?
Is there some quick and easy way to turn 1 million into 10 million...?
...Huh?
Hey, hey! You there, the handsome guy who looks like he has a lot of free time!
Would you like to come play with us this afternoon?
Wait, what's this about?
Do you know what day today is?
It's an event day with a very, very special event!
Exactly! The Bunny Empire has finished its renovation...
And today is the grand reopening!!
Bunny... Empire?
Huh? No way, you don't know the Bunny Empire, the largest casino in Humanitas?
If you don't know the Bunny Empire in Humanitas, you must be a spy!
...Well, I only recently settled in Humanitas.
Wow! Then you meet the requirements for our second event too!
That's right! A special tourist perk! You get a special bonus when you exchange your chips!
Combining events one and two, it's a double chip exchange event!!Everyone
D-Double?!
Yes, yes! It's a special perk available only today!
Of course, you know you can't immediately cash out the extra chips from the double event, right?
You have to come! That way we can get our bonu—ahem, I mean, we can have fun playing together!
Goodbye then! See you later!
A special grand opening event...
...Alright, it's all or nothing. Let's win big!!

103020.t: Bunny Empire
Welcome to the Bunny Empire!

Slot machines, poker, blackjack, roulette...
Try any game you like, and may luck be on your side!
A casino... Just what you'd expect from the city of money, Humanitas.
More importantly...
Hehehe, now this is a feast for the eyes.
Now this is what a bunny casino should look like...!

But since I need to make money first today...
I wonder what the fastest and easiest way to earn is...

I sat down, figuring I'd try the slots first.
And ten minutes later...
Oh dear, valued guest... You were terribly unlucky!
How did you only get blanks... Not even a shred of beginner's luck...
I was completely cleaned out in just ten minutes...
My last 1 million, all gone...
Well, you can always try again once you get some more money!

It was just bad luck today!
I'm sure you'll do much better next time...!
Sighhh...
Hmm, I feel as though someone has absorbed all the bad luck around here—??????
Excellent. This is the exact moment to spin the slot machine one more time—??????
Lafine, stop that gambling-addicted android...!!??????
S-Seven, this is not the time for that!
But if I win now, a fortune—
Ugh, seriously—

...A problem has occurred in the process, and it must be restarted.
Restarting automatically.
For more details about this problem and possible fixes, refer to...
Just follow me in autopilot mode for now. Don't wander off, got it?
Sigh, of all days, everything is falling apart today...
Executing administrator Caren's command...
Ahahaha... S-Sorry!
...What was that? I mean—
My 1 million Credits!!!
Ultimately, I was kicked out of the casino after doing nothing but freeloading on their free drinks.
Humanitas Street
*Sigh*... That was my last bit of money. Am I really going to have to live on water again...?
I knew I shouldn't have gambled... How am I going to make up for this?
Maybe I should check the Fixer agency board...
Just as I was rummaging through my pockets while crossing the crosswalk...
SCREEECH!!!
Hey!!! Are you crazy? What were you thinking, jumping into the road out of nowhere?!??????
W-What just...

People shouldn't just wander into the road!
You'll dent the car!!!??????
What kind of bullshit is th— *Ghk*

Hey!! Hey!! Oh, give me a break.
Why are you the one passing out?!??????
Saverim Recovery Room
Mmm... Where am I...?
Oh, you're awake!??????
Nurse! Nurse! The patient is awake!??????
Thank you, Eileen!??????
, are you feeling alright???????
Well, my eyes are open, at least...
Goodness... Last time you collapsed in an alley...??????
You really need to take better care of your body!??????
Sophia, is he going to be okay???????
Yes, he's perfectly fine other than a minor impact. Though, it's quite surprising that he passed out just from getting bumped by a car...

Is your car alright, Charlotte?
You must have been so startled...
...Hey. The more I listen, the more I wonder why you're worrying about the car instead of me, the guy who got hit by it.
More importantly... Aren't you that delivery guy from before... Lucky Per—

It's Lucky Truck, Lucky Truck!
I've delivered packages to your "base" so many times, and you forgot already?!
You even worked part-time for us last week, yet you forgot so quickly? You foolish Servant.
...? Did I?

What are you talking about? I even gave you all the invoices.
Did getting hit by the car wipe your memory?
Hello? Hey, are you listening to me, you foolish Servant?
Ah, I'm listening. I'm listening.
...So, what were we talking about?
*Sigh*... You really are a manservant who never listens...
Anyway, the truck is in better shape than I thought, so there's nothing for you to pay for.
Watch the lights properly next time!

Right, I was a bit distracted... But what do you mean pay for damages?!
Aren't cars supposed to be the ones being careful?!

Huh? What are you talking about? Even if a dump truck or a road roller
hits someone at full throttle, an average person wouldn't get hurt, you know?

On the other hand, if a car collides with something, it's bound to get wrecked.
So you always have to handle them with care.
I mean, it's true you should handle cars with care, but...

Exactly!! Of course I'm more worried about the car.
The bumper gets smashed, the axle gets bent, the tires pop off...

Every single one of those things costs money! Money!
We got lucky this time since it was just a light tap and nothing broke.

Meanwhile, you are completely fine.
Right?

Don't play dumb.
You don't even have a single scrape or scratch. Right?
...Ah. Um. Uh...

Arghhh!!! It hurts so bad!!!
I feel like my whole body is falling apart! Aaagh!!!
That is the most obvious terrible acting I've ever seen! Who do you think you're fooling!!!
P-Please don't fight, everyone!
Whoa, so heavy— Mmph!! Mmph, mmph!!!
Ah! I-I'm so sorry! But you shouldn't use violence on a patient!

That's right.
No matter how much it seems like they're faking, one must always be careful...
Is it just me, or was that a passive-aggressive jab?
Huh? Whatever do you mean by that...?
Don't worry, that's just how they are here.
Even if my Servant is basically an insurance scammer, they'll still look after you with all their heart.

So while you were knocked out, I brought you here just in case.
Be grateful.
That's a bit harsh. And besides, I don't even have insurance.
Then you should've been more careful before stepping into the street! Are you trying to bankrupt me?!
What are you talking about?! I'm the one who's going bankrupt here!!
Wait, what on earth do you mean by...
...I blew our office's entire savings of 1,000,000 Credits on the Bunny Empire, so now I'm broke.
Hey! What's with that reaction?!
*Sigh*... never mind. Right. I guess that's possible, for my manservant...
Why, you...
Hmm... But I wonder, did you perhaps hit your head hard during the accident?
Not knowing the basic fact that humans are sturdier than vehicles... Maybe you really do have short-term memory loss...

What...?!
But that sounds really serious!
Quick, we need some medicine... or some treatment... Oh no, oh no...

Oh! Should I go get Rana?! I'm sure Rana has some medicine...!
Or maybe even a shot...!
...Ugh, I don't even have insurance. What do you mean medicine and shots?
I don't have the money for that, so I'll be leaving—

Ah, no! A patient must stay in bed!
Even if we don't use shots or medicine, I was taught you must get examined!
Mmph, mmph, mmph—!!
Phew!! I just barely survived, and now you're trying to kill me again?!
Okay!! I get it! I'll stay still, so get off me!!
Wonderful!! Complete bed rest is key for patients!
Seriously, I am completely fine...

If you keep saying that, I'm going to pin you down again!
I might just flatten you like a pancake!

Alright, alright!!
I don't mind the pinning, but at least let me breathe...

103030.t: A few hours later, while lying in the recovery room...
Saverim Recovery Room
What? Dan Xi, what are you doing here?
I should be the one asking that. Why are you in the recovery room?

Ah, I got hit by a truck while crossing the street...
and when I woke up, I was in an isekai.

Since when is a hospital an isekai?!
And let me repeat: you jumped into the street!!
Ah, whatever. That's what happened.

Hmm... How strange. Is it not common sense to remain unscratched
even after being struck by a giant iron carriage?
I suspect you have been neglecting your physical training far too much.
Is that really something you can solve with training?

Haha, to some extent, yes.
So, are you hurt anywhere?
Well, I lost consciousness for a bit, but other than that I'm completely fine. I think I can get up now.
...Of course, I don't want to get knocked out again, so I'll stay lying down quietly until the checkup is done.

Hmm, to be carried in just from being hit by a car.
Has your body been ailing since our last encounter?
I shall procure some Four Gentlemen special Gongjindan for you next time.
Ugh, just hearing the name makes me taste the bitterness on the tip of my tongue...
By the way, I think someone else needs medicine more than me. Who's that on your back?
*Cough* *cough*... Ugh...
A companion of mine. I was already planning to do something about her condition.
I know not what struck her... but ordinary medicine seems of no use.
Rather, she exhibits symptoms akin to those exposed to an evil aura...
What do you mean, "evil aura"? Should we call a shaman or something?

More importantly, is she even in any condition to move?
She looks in way worse shape than me.

According to her test results, there's physically nothing wrong with her...
So there wasn't anything we could do.
It feels a bit odd to say this as a medical practitioner, but why don't you try visiting Vermont?
I've heard the high priestesses of the Harmonix Faith are quite well-versed in these matters.

Indeed, that is an option.
It is closer than Four Gentlemen, after all...
You have my thanks. I shall do so at once.
So, are my test results out yet?

Ah, yes!
They just came in.

Fortunately, your body is completely fine.
Squeaky clean, without a single bruise.
I had to strip naked and take X-rays for this checkup, shouldn't that much be obvious just by looking?
, you have no health records on file...
But it's always better to be thorough with these things, right?
Anyway, we're done here, right? I'm getting up. No pinning me down with your chest again, okay?
Hm? What are you talking about? I was just making sure you didn't move!
Anyway, since Sophia guaranteed you're fine, you're free to get up now!
Good, I can finally get out of here.
I need to quickly make 1,000,000 Credits to somehow make up for—
I don't think it'll stop at a million, though.

What's that supposed to mean?
What are you talking about?
What do you think? You ruined my day, manservant, so I'm charging you for it.

I even paid your medical bills in advance.
Since you don't have insurance, it cost me 300,000 Credits!
Wow, that's wild. Well, I don't have 300,000 Credits, so I can't pay you back.
I wasn't planning on asking for cash anyway!!!

Just come over later and help out with some work.
Without a Servant, we're short-handed on moving cargo and cleaning.
If you provide a decent salary and three meals a day as benefits, I'll think about it.
Well, as long as you work diligently, I'll make sure your daily wage is solid.
Are you even eating properly these days? You're so weak from not eating enough, no wonder you passed out after getting hit by a car.
...Normally, would eating better really make you able to survive getting hit by a car?

Still, it seems you have time for this kind of idle banter.
Are you free today?

Today's deliveries were finished ages ago.
I was actually planning to relax and take a good rest for once, but...
I got caught up in a traffic accident on my way back because of you.
I was actually worried that your frail, pathetic body might have gotten seriously hurt, okay?
...Could you pick one between teasing me for being weak or actually worrying about me?
Anyway, you're still keeping busy, Ms. Hands-On CEO.

Tell me about it.
Delivering anything, anywhere, perfectly is our company motto, after all.
But with so many petty thieves around lately, doing business is getting tough.
...Are there really that many thieves these days? Our hideout's never been broken into.
Well, that's because you're poor.
Can you stop hitting me with hard facts? We're practically in the same boat here.

We at least make enough to get by.
Anyway...
Petty thieves are one thing, but package thieves are the worst lately.
We make in-person handovers a rule, so we haven't had any major incidents, but other companies are suffering crazy losses.
Just how bad is it for you to say that?
Sometimes a package gets stolen the very second it's dropped off at a doorstep and the delivery person turns their back!
Apparently, videos of people baiting thieves with fake packages have become a huge trend.
What, are they baiting them by making glitter bombs or something?

There were glitter bombs, glue-spraying machines, foul-odor devices...
Oh, and there was even a rumor that someone used an anti-tank grenade...
...The world of package delivery is absolutely brutal.

At this rate, the police must not be doing anything at all, right?
I already knew they were understaffed, but for public security to be this terrible...
*Sigh* I have a lot to say about that too, but...
What? What's going on?
Ah, ! We actually just had a client arrive...
And I think you should come over right away!
Huh? What, is it a request?
Well, yes, but... you'll see once you get here!

Anyway, please come as fast as you can!
Really, as fast as possible!
Fixer work?
...It's our first request in a week, but what's the big rush?
I'll go, of course, but no matter how fast I run from here, it's going to take...
Oh.

What's with that look, Servant?
Why are you staring at me like that?

103040.t: Hideout

Alright, you said it was urgent, so I rushed back!!
Just what kind of request is it—
We have a huge problem! A huge problem!!!
Whoa!!! Getting slammed into once is more than enough for today!!!

...?
Slammed into, by what...?
A-Anyway! What's so urgent that you had to call me back like this—
Ah, that would be...

Kyaaaah! No!!!
Don't poke me!

This is client abuse.
Our leader will not take this lying down.
What do you mean by that?? ??????
You're throwing away a chance to become the foundation for the glorious research of Chronoscholar?! ??????
No, but why are you so obsessed with taking a blood sample in the first place?
I hate needles! They're scary!!

For your information, I can block pain.
But I still dislike needles.
Um, excuse me...
Huh? I hate needles too! ??????

I don't even need a syringe!
Why are you making such a simple magical process so complicated?! ??????

How can I believe that?!
That's exactly the lie they tell at hospitals before they stick you!

Precisely.
If it is not a syringe, that only implies you will use a more painful method.
Ah, this is so frustrating!!! ??????
Is this the "emergency" you were talking about?
Well, yes...
Our client has been poking around for a while now, claiming she "senses a peculiar energy from the people here"...
Peculiar energy? What is she, a cult recruiter?
Are you sure she's a client and not a scammer?
A scammer? That is absurd! ??????
I am the head of Chronoscholar, the historic magic family of Vermont!
You should address me as Lady Yuria!
...Don't tell me you have no idea who I am?
No? And besides, this isn't Vermont anyway.
...Ugh.
More importantly, didn't you say you came to request a job? Why are you just standing around without stating your business?
*Sigh*... The request is important, but as a mage, this is just as crucial!
I sense an energy here that might finally offer a new breakthrough for my stagnant research.
Therefore, I must obtain blood samples to identify the nature of this energy.
For free?
Huh?

If you want something from a Fixer, you should show some cash first.
Do you really think it makes sense to just barge in and demand blood?
Back where I'm from, they at least show some consideration by giving you cookies or snacks when they draw your blood.
...Hmm. I cannot argue with that.
Fine! How about 100,000 Credits per person?
(S-She's offering that much? Just how loaded is she?)
130,000 Credits!
Why does the price keep going up?!
Ahaha... I just wanted to see how high you'd go.
By the way, my lady, you really have no knack for negotiating, do you? If you make your desires too obvious, you lose all your leverage...
Hmph, playing that game, are we?
I was planning on giving you a hefty reward for the request, but if that's how it is, I'll just do this myself!
...Just how much are we talking?
About this much...
One, ten, hundred, thousand, ten thousand, hundred thousand, million...

I apologize for my insolence, Lady Yuria!!
How much blood do you require?!
Big Boss?! Are you selling us out??
I never expected this. You are the worst.
Oh my, what a betrayal...
Now, now. For the sake of magical progress, this is a simple—
I am so glad to hear you say that.
Now, starting with you...
Aaagh?!!
Ugggh... What on earth was that...?
Ugh... Never again...
I feel violated. This is the worst.
Fufufu, actually, I might have enjoyed it...
I merely collected the samples another way since you didn't want needles, so why the fuss?
In the magic academy, this level of sample collection is just part of daily life.
Being bound by tentacles and having them shoved down your throat is daily life?!
I want to visit that academy. Right now.

That's not what I meant...
*Sigh* You're not even listening, are you?
Now then, shall we discuss the request?

103050.t: Lucky Truck Vehicle
So why do I have to play chauffeur for my Servant again?!
And not just for my manservant, but for his client too—!!
Because right now, I'm the employer and you're the Servant?

What? You said you had no more deliveries today anyway.
Acting as our taxi driver shouldn't be an issue.

Who are you calling a Servant?!
Sigh...
Since this is a rare opportunity, I'll call you "Servant" as much as I want.
Tsk, I should have just left and ignored your call when I was starting up the engine to go back.
Just so you know, I'm going to charge you full price for fuel plus a hefty tip.
Ah, boss! I got your call!

Jennie, prepare an invoice and a contract for M.A.D.
We need to squeeze out way more than just the vehicle rental fee.
Hey. I can hear you, you know.

Ah, yes...!!
Wait, are you... with my savior right now...?
*Sigh*... Jennie.
I know that Servant helped you out when he fell from the sky, but—
Ahhh! M-Miss—I mean, Boss!! You said you'd keep that a secret—
I-I'll get the documents ready at a nearby internet cafe for now!
Right, and don't forget to charge for the internet cafe and printing fees.
Whoa, but how is there still space left even with all of us inside?
It didn't look nearly this spacious from the outside!
At first, I wondered if such a shabby vehicle would be alright, but it's actually not bad.
If I had to nitpick, it's just that it's a bit dirty.

Well, excuse me for having such a shabby, dirty truck.
It's still been expanded with top-of-the-line spatial expansion tech, you know.
Thanks to that, we can carry a massive amount of cargo all at once, but...
Our cleaner has been taking a break from their part-time job lately.
By the way, who's driving? Is it on autopilot?
Is there any car without autopilot these days? I only take the wheel when we're in a real rush.
Like when we took you to the hospital...
Huh? The hospital?
It's a long story. Just roll with it.
Anyway, Yuria. Can you tell me the details of the request one more time?
*Sigh*... I literally just told you. Were you not paying attention?
Our family came to Humanitas for a long-overdue vacation, but...
While I went to investigate a strange energy I felt, they all scattered—
Ah, right. You said they went missing?

I'm not the one who's lost!
Those two just decided to wander off on their own!!
They're both so selfish... The moment I take my eyes off them, they vanish...

If you'd tied them up with those tentacles
like you did to us earlier, it would've been quite a show.
T-Tentacles?? Bondage play...?
C-Can you not make it sound so weird?! They aren't just normal tentacles, they're a manifestation of temporal Shackle Magic—
Yeah, yeah. That's enough of your boring, pedantic magic talk.
Urgh...
Anyway, tell me about the two of them.
If we're going to find them, we at least need to know who they are and what they usually do.

*Sigh*... Right.
I suppose you're right.

The first is Claire.
She's a homunculus that has been passed down in our family for generations.
Powerful magic comes with powerful mana backlash. So she's a magical lifeform whose body was engineered to withstand it.
The "ultimate body," huh? Must be pretty huge and powerful.
Your intentions sound rather impure, but you're not wrong.
Except... because of that, her body was designed rather inefficiently.
She has a constitution that constantly requires a massive amount of protein in addition to mana.
So basically, she eats a lot of meat.
Meat is her top priority, but she tends to stuff anything edible into her mouth...
And she has an incredibly keen sense of smell, so she's amazing at sniffing out protein. I just hope she isn't raiding some meat restaurant right now... *Sigh*...
Speaking of a massive amount of protein around here... Ah.
There's only one place it could be...
It has to be that place, right?
It seems we have no choice but to go there again.
...? Yuria & Charlotte
Tofu Street
*Munch munch*...
One more of every tofu dish here.
Man, we're completely cleaned out of tofu today...

Us too!
I don't even remember the last time we ran completely out of stock...

Wow, she can really pack it away.
How does all that even fit in there?

Seriously!
But she does have the money to pay for all this, right?
Of course.

Money is not an issue.
My lady gave me a black credit card with no limit.
It's definitely around here somewhere... Hm?
Several dozen minutes later...
... Kasa & Rona
U-Um... Do you... not have any money?
Hm. I must have dropped it somewhere.
Put it on my tab.

Whoa, this is getting crazy.
I'll drop you off here before the car actually gets scratched, okay?
Good luck!

A fight breaking out is exactly what I expected.
We need to clean this up first.
Woohoo! That's our specialty!!
Today's snack is a tofu sample.
Ahaha, it's a complete mess today too!

*Sigh*...
Claire, seriously...

Hey, Victoria.
Looks like our client's friend caused a bit of trouble?

Huh?
Wait, she was a Fixer colleague of yours?
I guess yesterday's ally is today's enemy!
It's not like I want to fight you guys.
But if we don't do this, you guys are just going to keep going wild.
Ahaha! That's true!

Wait, isn't this just a matter of paying the bill?!
Why are you taking it this far?
If we back out now, it's going to be a huge pain later!
No, but I mean, why—

Look, my lady.
The others are fighting among themselves. Infighting?
W-What on earth...
Ahaha, they saw an opening and jumped on the easy target!
That's how you grab the best spot!

So slow on the uptake.
Hey, just blast us with something big.
We have to at least pretend to fight so things are easier for us later, get it?
Urgh... W-Well, if that's how it is...
Haaah—!!

Hyaah...!
W-What is with these tentacles?!
Ah, the tentacle is slipping under my mask... Mmph...!
Mmm... I-It's wrapped around my tail too, and it feels... hng...

They're kind of bouncy, like tofu...
Hya! Don't touch me there!
Aha. Lewd tentacles. Definitely lewd tentacles.

S-Shut up!!!
I didn't mean for that to happen!!
Wait, I definitely gave you the card! Where did you put it?!

I am sorry, my lady.
I'm sure I put it somewhere after you gave it to me...
Our ancestors surely put enough effort into your memory capacity when they made you, so why do you only forget things when you're distracted by food...
...Don't tell me you ate the card too? Right?
I have never eaten a card before.

Then did you put it between those uselessly huge breasts of yours?
You used to put a cup there to drink while lying down.

My nutrient reservoirs are not useless, my lady.
